Why Work With Us

Mining insiders.
World-class storytellers.

The result? Content that is safe, accurate, operationally credible, and visually outstanding. Content that your team is proud to share, and that your audiences trust.

M

Morten

Lead Photographer & Director

Former mining engineer turned visual journalist. Morten has spent 12 years documenting the global mining industry — from the deep gold mines of South Africa to Arctic copper operations in Canada. His work has appeared in Mining Magazine, The Financial Times, and company annual reports for several of the world's largest producers.

Underground Photography Documentary Film Investor Relations Africa & Americas
P

Paul

Writer & Editorial Director

Mining journalist and technical writer with a background in geology. Paul brings editorial rigour and a storyteller's eye to every project. He has reported from more than 30 countries, covering exploration, development, production, and closure — with bylines in Bloomberg, Engineering & Mining Journal, and industry reports for governments and development banks.

Technical Writing ESG Reporting Investor Communications Australasia & Europe
